description_en: Queries the service resources that are added to an endpoint service
description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServiceResources接口查询终端节点服务中的服务资源
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink list-vpc-endpoint-service-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVpcEndpointServiceResources

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the service resource.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务资源的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If this is your first request and no next requests are to be performed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

If a next request is to be performed, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If no value is returned for NextToken, no next requests are performed.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

items.description_en: The information about the array object

AutoAllocatedEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic resource allocation is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
AutoAllocatedEnabled.description_zh:
是否允许自动分配，取值：

true：是。

false：否

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the service resource

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the service resource is deployed

RelatedDeprecatedEndpointCount.description_en: The number of endpoints that are associated with the service resource that is smoothly migrated
RelatedDeprecatedEndpointCount.description_zh: 平滑迁移场景下，作为被替换的服务资源关联的终端节点的连接数量

RelatedEndpointCount.description_en: The number of endpoints that are associated with the service resource
RelatedEndpointCount.description_zh: 服务资源关联的终端节点的连接数量

ResourceSupportIPv6.description_en:
Indicates whether IPv6 is enabled for the endpoint service. Valid values:

true

false
ResourceSupportIPv6.description_zh:
终端节点服务是否支持IPv6功能。取值：

true：是。

false：否

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the service resource.

Only slb is returned. This value indicates a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
ResourceType.description_zh:
服务资源的类型。

slb：表示服务资源类型为传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）。

alb：表示服务资源类型为应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。

nlb：表示服务资源类型为网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）。
gwlb : 表示服务资源类型为网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the service resource belongs
VSwitchId.description_zh: 服务资源所属的交换机

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the service resource belongs

ZoneId.description_en: The ID of the zone to which the service resource belongs
ZoneId.description_zh: 服务资源所属的可用区
